I am 75 years old and have been farming these fields in Quzhou since I was a boy. I never went to school, but I know this land and this weather. The soil here is good loam, and we have wells for irrigation. I have about 6 mu of contracted land. My son helps me with the heavy work and machine operations now, but I make the decisions.

This year, I will do what I have always done: plant winter wheat in October and follow it with summer maize after the wheat harvest in early June. That is the rotation every household in our village follows. It is the safest choice. The wheat price has been steady around 1.2 yuan per jin, and maize is about 0.85 yuan per jin. I do not want to take risks with cotton or vegetables at my age—I do not have the labor or the market connections for that.

For the wheat, I will buy the improved "Shimai" or "Liangxing" variety seed from the village supply store. I will spread about 30 jin of seed per mu. Before sowing, I will rotary till the field after the maize stalks are chopped. For fertilizer, I will put down a compound fertilizer bag (about 100 jin per mu of the 18-22-5 formula) as basal, and then topdress with urea at jointing stage. That gives the wheat enough nitrogen and phosphorus. I will irrigate four times: once before winter to help it survive the cold, once at jointing, once at heading, and once during grain filling. I will spray pesticides about four times—herbicide once after sowing, and then insecticide and fungicide two or three times when the weather gets humid and the diseases appear. I expect about 1,000 jin per mu, which is 500 kg.

For the maize, I will plant hybrid seed—probably "Nongda 372" or "Denghai 605"—right after the wheat harvest without deep ploughing. Everyone uses no-tillage now with the seed drill; it saves time and the moisture in the soil. I will use about 80 to 100 jin per mu of compound fertilizer (28-6-6) at sowing, and maybe side-dress some urea at the big trumpet leaf stage if the plants look yellow. I will irrigate twice, usually once at the jointing/tasseling stage and once during grain filling if the rain is insufficient. Pesticide sprays will be about four times: herbicide, and then insecticide for the corn borer. I expect about 1,200 jin per mu, which is 600 kg.

This plan is steady. It feeds my family, leaves some grain to sell, and I know every step by heart.
